messages:
sasha_marketing: Quick check-in 1: finalizing the Q2 benchmark mailwave + webinar invites. Need owners for subject, segments, windows, and suppression. Can we lock today?
jamie_content: Ill take subjects and preheader. will post 3 variants in 30m. prefer to A/B test the "Data-first" subject vs "Webinar-first" CTA.
leo_growth: I'll take segmentation + send pacing. Proposed windows: US Wed 10am ET, EU Wed 3pm BST, APAC Thu 7pm SGT. Stagger by region to limit spikes. Recommend 48h non-open resend to a 20% creative variant.
maria_ops: Suppressions: remove anyone in last 14d who clicked, and exclude customers on Dedicated contracts. I'll export lists and drop to the campaign tool. Link: https://drive.example.com/q2bench/suppressions (request access).
kira_design: Landing two variants done: /lp/q2bench-data and /lp/q2bench-webinar. Shared image assets and a compact hero for mobile. Please use UTM: utm_campaign=q2bench_orbit&utm_medium=email.
luis_analytics: Metrics to track: opens, CTR to register, RSVP rate, and report downloads. Baselines: open 24% for High-engagement, CTR 8%. Will create dashboard and tag events.
jamie_content: Draft subjects (short):
```
1) Q2 benchmark: inference cost & latency, side-by-side
2) Live: benchmark walkthrough + live Q&A (Wed)
3) How teams cut inference spend: key takeaways + report
```
sasha_marketing: Owners: jamie -> copy, leo -> segments & schedule, maria -> suppression export, kira -> landing assets, luis -> tracking/dashboard. I'll own final send approval.
campaign-bot: Reminder: Campaigns must be scheduled in Campaign Manager by 18:00 PT Tue to pick up exports.
leo_growth: Will upload segmented CSVs and cron settings by 6:30pm PT. Pacing: ramp 1k/min, cap 8k/hr for main cohort.
maria_ops: Suppression file uploaded and shared. Please confirm access.
jamie_content: Locking copy at 5pm PT; uploading HTML + text to assets folder.
luis_analytics: Dashboard wired; will validate events after first send and share a pulse doc.
sasha_marketing: Perfect. Post-send check at +2h for deliverability + 24h performance to decide the 48h resend cohort. Thanks all :rocket:
